Proposition
[Flat metrics (Proposition 35.5)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0305 1. ch35:35.5\group Linear Stability

If $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ is flat, then $\Delta _L=\Delta $ is negative semidefinite on $S^2$, with kernel exactly the parallel $(2,0)$-tensors. Thus the kernel has dimension at most $n(n+1)/2$ and every flat metric is linearly stable for Ricci--DeTurck flow.
